{{Quote|If you wanted a quick death, you came to the right place!|T'rubba|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''T'rubba''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] criminal who was a henchman of a [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. A blue-skinned Twi'lek, T'rubba used two [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibroswords]] in battle, and his lieutenants were known as "Dead Faced Blasters."<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
T'rubba appears as one of the possible Henchmen Bounties in the Bounty Contract Week, a recurring World Event added to the [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.3. T'rubba can be summoned by using Rendezvous Beacon B-12, which appears on the planets [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and [[Voss]]. The player has the option to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him or capture him alive with [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], so as a result, this article refrains from assuming which crime lord he worked for, where he was encountered, and his fate.<ref name="TOR" />
